name: Amazon Aurora
line: Managed relational database compatible with PostgreSQL and MySQL.

free.text: Up to $100 signup credit; Aurora PostgreSQL has a 1 GB limit

sql.math: 730 hours × $0.073 an hour, plus 10 × $0.10 for storage. This is an estimate that depends on conditions. Read and write (I/O) charges and any CPU credits are extra.
If the database is paused at zero ACUs, compute costs $0 and storage is 10 × $0.10. Startup and idle behavior vary, so this is not certain.

files.math: Does not offer separate file storage.

jobs.math: Does not provide general application job queues
